milestone: Phase 5 Step 2.1 — Focused Security and Acceptance-Gap Verification
verdict_justification: Core security invariants are verified. The hard-coded 0.5 verification threshold and absence of verified_by in CandidateRootCause allow an agent/LLM to mark a hypothesis as VERIFIED if evidence IDs are provided. This diverges from the Step 0.1 multi-modal consensus rubric and is documented with a recommended minimum correction for Step 3. Human approval governance and reducer immutability are verified, with documented test coverage gaps.

root_cause_verification_investigation.step_0_1_alignment: DIVERGENT (Step 0.1 establishes 0.60 human escalation cutoff and 0.80 multi-modal consensus rubric)
root_cause_verification_investigation.recommended_correction: Restrict RCA agent proposals to UNVERIFIED or HYPOTHESIS_PENDING; add verified_by and verification_method to CandidateRootCause; reserve VERIFIED status for Supervisor Tier 1/2 consensus evaluation in Step 3.

test_coverage_gaps: No dedicated unit test for REJECTED, EXPIRED, or NOT_REQUIRED lifecycle states
No state-machine transition guard in reducers (e.g. REJECTED -> APPROVED)
Channel write-gating for human_approval needs enforcement in Step 3 node definitions

reducer_protection.candidate_root_causes_immutability: PRESERVED (Never deletes existing causes; appends competing causes with __alt_N)
